subject: You're on {{to}} annual now
preheader: Your {{to}} plan is now billed yearly.
footer_note: You're getting this because you have a VF Tech plan. Billing emails like this one can't be turned off.
body: Your {{to}} plan is billed yearly from today at {{yearly_price}}, two months free compared with monthly. The unused part of this month was credited against the first year, and your receipt comes separately. You'll get a reminder 30 days before it renews.
